rawRecord.name: Cortex XSIAM SDK
rawRecord.short_description: Integrates with Cortex XSIAM SDK to provide command execution and semantic search over security automation content.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Wraps the Palo Alto Networks Demisto SDK to assist in developing security automation content for Cortex XSIAM/XSOAR platforms. Enables semantic search across 4,700+ playbooks, scripts, integrations, and XQL rules from the official content library using natural language queries. Provides SDK operations for scaffolding, formatting, validating, and linting security content, plus remote operations to list, download, upload content to XSIAM/XSOAR tenants and run commands or playbooks directly.
